data.title: Magic Moving Stars
data.description: Learn that the number of objects stays the same even when they move around!

challenges.instruction: Count the stars. Then watch them move!
challenges.hint: Tap each star slowly to count them all up.
challenges.narration: Let's count these stars together! Tap each one as we go.

challenges.instruction: Count the stars. Then watch them move!
challenges.hint: Remember how many we had, or tap them again to check!
challenges.narration: Look, they lined up! Do we still have the same amount?

challenges.instruction: Count the stars. Then watch them move!
challenges.hint: Count the stars in each group to be sure.
challenges.narration: The stars are grouping up! Let's see how many there are.

challenges.instruction: Count the stars. Then watch them move!
challenges.hint: Pick a starting star and go all the way around the circle.
challenges.narration: Around and around they go in a circle. How many are hiding here?

challenges.instruction: Count the stars. Then watch them move!
challenges.hint: Take your time and tap each star carefully.
challenges.narration: One last big move! Can you count all the stars on the board?
